dependency.shiftClickHint: Shift+click or long-press a card to center diagram on it
dependency.cardTypesHint: Untick a card type to take its cards, and every relation touching them, off the view. The card you are centered on is always shown.
dependency.showHierarchyMarkersHint: Mark cards that have a parent or children not shown — use the Reveal tools to bring them in
dependency.showCardLogosHint: Show each card's own logo when it has one, with the type icon as a small badge
dependency.hasHiddenParent: Has a parent not shown — use Reveal parent
dependency.hasHiddenChildren: Has children not shown — use Reveal children
dependency.showEndOfLifeHint: Include related cards that have reached End of Life by the date shown on the timeline. The card you are centered on is always shown.
dependency.persistRetiredHint: Keep retired cards on the diagram — ghosted and badged — at any date after their retirement. Turn off to show only the cards alive on the selected date.
dependency.previewPlannedHint: Show cards that have not started yet — ghosted and badged — at any date before their start, so you can see what is coming. Off keeps the landscape to what exists on the selected date.
dependency.showRelationLabelsHint: Draw each relation's verb on its line (supports, uses, …). Turn it off for a cleaner canvas on a dense landscape — the lines and their arrowheads still show what connects to what, and in which direction.
dependency.showRelationValuesHint: When a relation carries a qualifying value (e.g. Support Type «Leading»), show it next to the label, like supports [Leading]. Ticked yes/no details are listed too, like CRUD [Create · Read]. Relations without a value are unchanged.
dependency.aggregateByHint: Group the related cards into boxes and draw a single connector between any two boxes, labelled with how many relations it stands for. Relations between cards of the same box stay drawn inside it, and the card you are centered on stays on its own.
dependency.createDiagramAggregatedTitle: Create diagram from a grouped view
dependency.createDiagramAggregatedIntro: The diagram will be a snapshot of this grouped view:
dependency.createDiagramAggregatedCards: Cards stay live: every shape is linked to its inventory card, so perspectives, logos and sync keep working.
dependency.createDiagramAggregatedBoxes: Each box becomes a container you can move as one, with its cards inside.
dependency.createDiagramAggregatedConnec: The connectors between boxes are decoration. They show today's counts, do not follow the inventory, cannot be synced and are not flagged when relations change. Relations drawn inside a box stay real.
dependency.lineStyleHint: How connection lines are drawn when idle. Hovering a line always draws it solid, and a dependency being severed keeps its own dashes.
dependency.legendPlanned: Not yet live at the selected date
dependency.legendGainedLink: Gains a connection at this marker
dependency.legendLostLink: Loses a connection at this marker

cost.drillHint: Click: open card · Right click: analyse

cost.fiscalYearHelp: Annual costs of the cards live in this fiscal year — from the year they go Active through the year of their End of Life, in full and never pro-rated. Cards retired in an earlier fiscal year are left out.
cost.attributionHelp: Full puts the whole cost of a related card on every card it links to, and the total counts it once. Split equally divides it by the number of cards it links to, so the tiles add up to the total.
